sources.ancestry: One shared source family across all twelve series and any overlapping suite Energy use

claims.text: Zero of twelve U.S. petroleum series crossed the predeclared absolute robust-z threshold of 3.5.
Gasoline and distillate stocks were 7.40% and 14.89% below comparable year-earlier levels and both drew in the latest source week.
The verified evidence does not support a registered broad petroleum anomaly or isolate a causal explanation.
The latest source week ended 25 September, so the requested 28 September–4 October week, gas/LNG/electricity, and matched Weather/GEV controls remain unobserved.

limitations: Current-vintage history cannot establish historical first-release values or surprise revisions.
All measured series share EIA ancestry and are correlated; suite Energy overlap is not independent confirmation.
The requested event week has no source-period endpoint in the verified archive.
Gas, LNG, electricity, operator-outage, and matched Weather/GEV controls were unavailable or unimplemented.
Product supplied is a flow proxy rather than end-user consumption; the robust-z threshold is uncalibrated.
